system.description: You can speak with all manner of wild things—animals, plants, and spirits. When you meet, they know of you. Roll their bond with you or spend thread to establish it. When you call, those nearby will answer. You always sense the presence of hidden dangers in places teeming with wildlife.

notes.description: Not everything communicates as we do—plants may only impart feelings, spirits might need an offering to even appear. Change it up and make the world feel alive.
